notes.title: Update #9 - 7th Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Full Release version 2023-02-14 changelog:
- More initial time in the Endurance Course (Course 1 To 6).
- Stage notifications / times are now displayed higher - better vision when passing checkpoints.
- Upgrading from x86 to x64 binaries for better compatibility and performance.
- Leaderboards are now displayed on the Title Menu, new option to only display friends scores, and paging support by pressing L1/R1 or Left Stick / Arrows / WASD.
- Stats are displayed on the Title Menu.
- Updated the About section with flyers of current and upcoming games.

Super Night Riders was first released on Steam in February 2016 - 7 years ago.

Super Night Riders S1 (Season One) - the full remake - is planned for this year. Please add it to your wishlist to be notified on the release:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1836660

Super Night Riders S2 (Season Two) - the sequel with 100% new content - is also in the work.

Thanks for your support for all these years ːlyingcatː

Hi everyone!

Mark the date: Episode 2 of my Japanese-style RPG series Light Fairytale will release via Early Access on this Monday 24 May at 9:00 am PDT ːshokkuː

notes.title: Update on Light Fairytale Episode 2 (September 2020)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022398/540fbb12c1d76a8b3f7628cc3932493208896138.jpg

Hey guys! Here's a quick update about the current status and plans for episode 2 of my JRPG series Light Fairytale.

I've been focusing on the development of episode 2 since December 2019 and I'm happy to announce that it is now playable from start to finish in term of exploration and events! Including 3 towns and 3 dungeons.

I will now work on the battle part. I've done preliminary work on the 5 boss battles but still need to implement their unique skills. I've also implemented many normal battles but still lacking quite a few.

After that, I'll work on implementing a few new features, then start the finalization / polishing / testing process. That's around the time when I'll launch the Early Access on Steam as I will need testers.

The Early Access should still happen this year. Please wishlist episode 2 to be notified on the release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

Here's a few work-in-progress screenshots. Again, thanks for your support and patience! This is a very ambitious project for a mostly solo effort, I'll hope you'll understand.

notes.title: Update on Light Fairytale Episode 2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022398/e5bf2d59c06ec5fd9b8ad2cd40cd5e41867100f4.png

Hi everyone, quick update about Episode 2 of my turn-based Japanese-style RPG series Light Fairytale.

After the full release of Episode 1 on Steam in May 2019, I've been working on the consoles ports - PlayStation 4 and Xbox One - until the last release in the end of November 2019.

I was only able to focus on Episode 2 since December 2019, though the development is progressing smoothly. I've implemented 2 towns and 1 dungeon, I'm currently working on the 2nd dungeon. I'm planning 3 towns and 3 dungeons overall for this episode which should release on Steam around July 2020.

If you haven't already, please add it to your wishlist to be notified on the release!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

You can stay updated about my projects by following me on Twitter: twitter.com/bakanekofr

notes.title: Update #8 - Anime, and more!
notes.notes:
- Added a (very) short Anime that shows up once when clearing all the achievements.
If you've cleared the game prior to this update, you can still view this video in the Extras section on the Main Menu.
- Upgraded from Unity 5.6 to Unity 2017.3: Better performance and stability.
- Better compression. The game is now only around 90 MB on Windows.
- Added a few more vertical resolutions: 1.25x, 1.50x, which looks better than 1.00x yet are not as slow as 2.00x.
- Sharper artworks when playing in 4K.
- Added the Anime character sheet of Alice in the Instruction Manual.

Thank you for your support!

Please give this update a try, and leave your impressions here or on the discussions!

notes.title: Update #3 - New Easy Mode
notes.notes:
Added a new Easy Mode that can be toggled on the Race sub-menu. Here's the changes on this mode:

- More time on the timer at the start of each race.
- Crashing on a rival rider will still slow you down, but the rival will now disappear, making it easier to continue the race.
This won't happen anymore on the Standard Mode, as suggested in the comments.
- A few achievements are disabled.
- The leaderboards are still active, but the points you'll get are halved.

notes.title: [EDITED] Update #2 - Improved Gameplay
notes.notes:
- Crashing on a rival rider will still slow you down, but the rival will now disappear, making it easier to continue the race.
- When completing a race, you'll now get 25.000 points per second left on the timer (2x more than before).
- When passing close to a rival without crashing, you'll now get 5.000 points per rival (also 2x more than before).
- Added 2 help screens in the About sub-menu.
- Many fixes.

It is now possible to get even higher scores than before, so see you guys on the leaderboards!

[EDIT]
The rival disappearing will now happen only on the new Easy Mode, as suggested in the comments. Please check out Update #3.
